NSFileProtectionCompleteWhenUserInactive is iOS17+; require runtime guard before accessing that symbol on iOS16. Native linkage/runtime behavior is unexecuted.
NSURLVolumeSupportsFileProtectionKey is a read-only NSNumber iOS14+ property and may be queried from any filesystem URL, including this exact attested directory and regular file.
Missing requested resource key is an unavailable observation, not a false/unsupported value; nil resource dictionary is a separate error observation.
NSURLFileProtectionKey is grouped among regular-file keys, so it is not substituted for original NSFileManager directory assertion.
